package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_runs_authorization_business_rules_inline: Handlers that contain complex permission matrices instead of delegating to policy or service logic.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func DeleteResourceHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	role := c.GetString("user_role")
	resourceOwner := c.GetString("resource_owner")
	currentUser := c.GetString("user_id")
	isAdmin := role == "admin"
	isOwner := resourceOwner == currentUser
	isModerator := role == "moderator"

	if isAdmin {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"status": "deleted by admin"})
		return
	}

	if isOwner {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"status": "deleted by owner"})
		return
	}

	if isModerator && c.Query("scope") == "limited" {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"status": "deleted by moderator"})
		return
	}

	c.JSON(http.StatusForbidden, gin.H{"error": "unauthorized"})
}
